assessments.summary: The exact construction, CKR embedding and optimality certificate, integral lower-bound averaging argument, and attaining labeling establish CKR(H_k)=(7k-6)/(8(k-1)), OPT(H_k)=1, and ratio 8(k-1)/(7k-6). For k=4, the reported 10 vertices, 24 rational-weight edges, CKR=11/12, OPT=1, and ratio 12/11 follow exactly.
scopeQualifications: The audit establishes the mathematical construction and exact values for every integer k>=3.
The claim of historical attribution to the classical Freund--Karloff midpoint family, and any priority characterization, was outside the correctness audit.
The resulting ratios approach 8/7 and do not improve the referenced 1.20016 lower benchmark, consistent with the claim that this is an exact baseline rather than a new lower bound.
evidenceIssues: Historical attribution and priority were not independently verified by the audit.
